units.source_text: 女子以一种遗憾而严肃的口吻，反复强调这里没有干那种行当的女人。

en.t: In a regretful and serious tone, the woman repeatedly insisted that there were no women of that sort here.

units.source_text: 岛村表示怀疑。女子认真起来，

en.t: Shimamura expressed doubt. The woman became earnest,

units.source_text: 但她退让一步说：想怎么干，全看艺妓自己，

en.t: but she conceded that what they chose to do was entirely up to each geisha herself,

units.source_text: 只是预先没向主家打招呼就外宿，得由艺妓本人负责。

en.t: only, if she spent the night away without notifying the house beforehand, the responsibility would be hers alone.

units.source_text: 后果如何，主家可就不管了。但是，

en.t: Whatever happened afterward, the house would have nothing more to do with it. But,

units.source_text: 如果事先向主家关照过，那就是主家的责任，

en.t: if she had informed the house in advance, then it would become the house owner's responsibility,

units.source_text: 他得管你一辈子，就是这点不同。

en.t: he would have to look after her for life; that was the only difference.
